method: comparative case (San Francisco vs Map Ta Phut)
definition: Polycentric governance = 'multiple independent actors mutually order their relationships... under a general system of rules' (V. Ostrom).
stakeholders: Govt + private + civil society coordinate 'around the agenda, not a hegemonic body'; partisan mutual adjustment.
temporality_detail: 'polycentricity as a dynamic process, not an event'; path dependency. No electoral cycle.
misalignment_detail: Models polycentric order as stable; electoral clock could perturb it.
gaps: Strongest 'coordination across levels' treatment; no electoral clock.
